methodologyNotes: Covers non-magnified (1x) reflex and red dot weapon sights sold at a published US MSRP, including tube, open-reflex, and enclosed-emitter designs for pistols, rifles, and shotguns. Excludes magnified optics (LPVOs, prism scopes), holographic weapon sights, and laser aiming units. Price is typical US MSRP in USD. sightType is an enum: 'tube', 'open-reflex', or 'enclosed-reflex'. dotSizeMoa is the aiming dot diameter in MOA (minute of angle); for circle-dot reticles this is the center dot only. reticleType is an enum: 'dot', 'circle-dot', or 'multi-reticle' (user-selectable). objectiveWindowMm is the clear aperture width in millimeters (tube inner diameter for tube sights, window width for reflex sights). batteryType is the cell model enum (e.g. 'CR2032', 'CR1632', 'CR123A', 'AA'). batteryLifeHrs is manufacturer-rated runtime in hours at a mid/nominal brightness setting; null if not disclosed. brightnessSettings is the total count of selectable brightness levels (integer, including night-vision levels). mountFootprint is the mounting standard enum (e.g. 'Aimpoint-Micro', 'Trijicon-RMR', 'Aimpoint-ACRO', 'Docter/Noblex', 'Weaver/Picatinny', 'proprietary'). weightGrams is the optic-only weight in grams excluding mount unless noted. lengthMm is overall length in millimeters. nightVisionCompatible is a boolean: true if it has dedicated NV-compatible brightness settings. motionActivation is a boolean: true if it has a motion/shake-awake auto on-off feature.
